entries.name: SMART Goal Builder
entries.summary: Turn a direction into a specific, realistic next step.

entries.name: Values & Valued Action
entries.summary: Clarify values and connect them with action.

entries.name: Values Review
entries.summary: Review alignment, drift, and a next value-aligned action.

entries.name: Skill Thermometer
entries.summary: Choose the state that feels closest and see skills that may fit.

entries.name: STOP
entries.summary: Pause, step back, observe, and proceed mindfully.

entries.name: Pros and Cons
entries.summary: Compare short- and long-term effects before acting.

entries.name: TIPP / TIP Your Body Chemistry
entries.summary: Body-based crisis-survival skills.

entries.name: Temperature
entries.summary: A TIPP body-chemistry option.

entries.name: Intense Exercise
entries.summary: A brief TIPP movement option when medically appropriate.

entries.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
entries.summary: Notice tension and release muscles progressively.

entries.name: Paced Breathing
entries.summary: Use a comfortable, slower breathing pace.

entries.name: Distraction / Wise Mind ACCEPTS
entries.summary: Short-term attention strategies for getting through a crisis.

entries.name: Activities
entries.summary: Redirect attention with a safe activity.

entries.name: Contributing
entries.summary: Redirect attention through a useful contribution.

entries.name: Comparisons
entries.summary: Use careful comparison as temporary distraction.

entries.name: Opposite Emotion
entries.summary: Briefly evoke a different emotion.

entries.name: Pushing Away
entries.summary: Temporarily set a crisis aside.

entries.name: Thoughts
entries.summary: Occupy attention with neutral thoughts.

entries.name: Sensations
entries.summary: Use a safe strong sensation temporarily.

entries.name: Self-Soothe with the Five Senses
entries.summary: Offer safe comfort through sight, sound, smell, taste, or touch.

entries.name: IMPROVE the Moment
entries.summary: Make a painful moment more workable.

entries.name: Imagery
entries.summary: Use supportive imagery in the moment.

entries.name: Meaning
entries.summary: Connect the moment with meaning.

entries.name: Prayer
entries.summary: Use prayer or a personally meaningful reflective practice.

entries.name: Relaxation
entries.summary: Choose a safe relaxing action.

entries.name: One Thing in the Moment
entries.summary: Narrow attention to this moment.

entries.name: Vacation
entries.summary: Take a brief, safe mental or practical break.

entries.name: Self-Encouragement
entries.summary: Use fair and supportive words.

entries.name: Radical Acceptance
entries.summary: Acknowledge facts that cannot be changed right now.

entries.name: Willingness
entries.summary: Choose an effective stance instead of willfulness.

entries.name: Recognizing States of Mind
entries.summary: Notice reasonable, emotion, and Wise Mind states.

entries.name: Wise Mind
entries.summary: Integrate emotion and reason with direct knowing.

entries.name: WHAT Skills
entries.summary: Observe, describe, and participate.

entries.name: Observe
entries.summary: Notice experience without needing to change it.

entries.name: Describe
entries.summary: Put words on what is directly observed.

entries.name: Participate
entries.summary: Enter fully into the current activity.

entries.name: HOW Skills
entries.summary: Practice non-judgmentally, one-mindfully, and effectively.

entries.name: Non-Judgmentally
entries.summary: Notice judgments and return to facts and consequences.

entries.name: One-Mindfully
entries.summary: Do one thing at a time with attention.

entries.name: Effectively
entries.summary: Focus on what works for the situation and goals.

entries.name: Positive Self-Talk
entries.summary: Develop a fair, believable, supportive response.

entries.name: Grounding
entries.summary: Reconnect with present sensory and body information.

entries.name: Mindfulness of Current Emotions
entries.summary: Observe an emotion as a changing experience without automatically reacting.

entries.name: Emotion Surfing
entries.summary: Apply wave-like observation to current emotion.

entries.name: Observing and Describing Emotions
entries.summary: Notice emotions, body sensations, urges, and context.

entries.name: Change an Emotion
entries.summary: Choose among Check the Facts, Problem Solving, Opposite Action, or observation.

entries.name: ABC PLEASE
entries.summary: Reduce vulnerability and build a life worth living.

entries.name: Accumulating Positive Emotions
entries.summary: Build positive experiences in the short and longer term.

entries.name: Accumulating Long-Term Positive Emotions
entries.summary: Connect values with goals and small actions that build positive experiences over time.

entries.name: Build Mastery
entries.summary: Practice achievable challenges that build competence.

entries.name: Cope Ahead
entries.summary: Rehearse a skillful response before a difficult situation.

entries.name: Treat Physical Illness
entries.summary: Attend to physical health needs and professional care.

entries.name: Balanced Eating
entries.summary: Review the curriculum's balanced-eating material.

entries.name: Avoid Mood-Altering Substances
entries.summary: Reduce avoidable substance-related emotional vulnerability.

entries.name: Balanced Sleep
entries.summary: Support a more regular and restorative sleep pattern.

entries.name: Exercise / Physical Activity
entries.summary: Use suitable movement to support wellbeing.

entries.name: Check the Facts
entries.summary: Separate observable facts from interpretations.

entries.name: Opposite Action
entries.summary: Act opposite when emotion does not fit facts or action is ineffective.

entries.name: Problem Solving
entries.summary: Define a changeable problem and test a solution.

entries.name: Accumulating Short-Term Positive Emotions
entries.summary: Plan a safe, realistic pleasant event that is possible now.

entries.name: Thought Records
entries.summary: Examine a hot thought and build a balanced alternative.

entries.name: Facing Fears / Exposure
entries.summary: Plan graduated practice with objectively safe situations.

entries.name: Fear Ladder
entries.summary: Order safe exposure practices from easier to harder.

entries.name: Challenging Negative Thoughts
entries.summary: Review evidence and create a balanced alternative.

entries.name: Recognizing Thinking Traps
entries.summary: Identify interpretation habits shaping a difficult thought.

entries.name: Worry Time
entries.summary: Defer extended worry to an optional planned period.

entries.name: Worry Tree
entries.summary: Separate actionable problems from hypothetical worry.

entries.name: Box Breathing
entries.summary: Use a configurable four-phase breathing timer.

entries.name: Five Factor Model
entries.summary: Map situation, thoughts, emotions, body, and behaviours.

entries.name: Case Map
entries.summary: Organize a recurring problem, stressors, and strengths.

entries.name: Clarifying Priorities
entries.summary: Balance objective, relationship, and self-respect priorities.

entries.name: DEAR MAN
entries.summary: Organize an effective request or refusal.

entries.name: GIVE
entries.summary: Support relationship effectiveness.

entries.name: FAST
entries.summary: Support self-respect effectiveness.

entries.name: Boundaries
entries.summary: Clarify and communicate limits.

entries.name: Walking the Middle Path
entries.summary: Look for a workable synthesis rather than an all-or-nothing position.

entries.name: The DIME Game
entries.summary: Consider how intensely to ask or say no using ten factors.

entries.name: Ask / Say No
entries.summary: Plan a request or refusal around priorities and intensity.

entries.name: Sleep Hygiene Planner / Checklist
entries.summary: Review sleep patterns and plan one realistic change.

entries.name: Behavioural Activation
entries.summary: Make one manageable, meaningful activity easier to start.

entries.name: Behaviour Chain Analysis
entries.summary: Map vulnerabilities, prompting event, links, consequences, and solutions.

entries.name: Missing Links
entries.summary: Explore why an intended effective behaviour did not happen.

entries.name: Gratitude Journaling
entries.summary: Record specific appreciation without forcing a mood change.

entries.name: Stages of Change
entries.summary: Reflect across six possible stages of change without a score or diagnosis.

entries.name: Urge Surfing
entries.summary: Notice and ride an urge without treating it as a command.

entries.name: Medication Checklist
entries.summary: Review source-backed medication adherence information; an interactive checklist is planned.

entries.name: Strengths & Focus
entries.summary: Explore strengths and focus qualities named in the source Skills & Strengths overview.
